terra.problem: “God brought Abram out” describes the LORD reminding Abram of his departure, but the reminder did not happen in Ur. Reframe the moment around Abram’s departure from Ur.

“Remembered in prayer” describes a later prayer, not an event in Ur. God’s giving Abram the name Abraham also happened later, not in Ur. Remove this moment or reframe it around God bringing Abram out of Ur.
